Accessibility test plan · VPAT / ACR preparation

Owner: engineering + accessibility tester. Status: draft, October 2026. Target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Output: an Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) using the VPAT® 2.x WCAG edition template.

Status, not claims: until the ACR is complete, say "working toward WCAG 2.2 AA; ACR in preparation." Never say "fully compliant."

1. Scope

SurfacePriority
Pilot student paths: sign-in, onboarding, Today, registration readiness, Ask Semester, sharing, settingsP0
Staff pilot paths: advisor caseload, registrar desk, institution consoleP0
Public siteP1
Remaining student and staff screensP2

2. Automated checks

  • axe-core in CI on every route of the preview build; serious and critical issues block merge.
  • Lint rules for accessible names on icon-only controls and labels on inputs.
  • Color contrast checked from tokens: body text 4.5:1, large text and UI parts 3:1.

3. Manual checks (each release on P0 paths)

CheckHowWCAG
Keyboard onlyComplete every P0 journey without a mouse; visible focus throughout; no traps2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 2.4.11
Screen readersNVDA + Firefox, JAWS + Chrome, VoiceOver + Safari (macOS and iOS)1.3.1, 4.1.2, 4.1.3
Zoom and reflow200% zoom and 320 px width without loss of content1.4.4, 1.4.10
Text spacingApply the text-spacing bookmarklet1.4.12
Target sizeInteractive targets at least 24×24 px (product standard 44 px)2.5.8
MotionReduced motion respected; nothing flashes2.3.1, 2.3.3
FormsLabels, instructions, error identification and suggestions, focus moves to first error3.3.1–3.3.3, 3.3.7
Time limitsSession timeout warns and allows extending2.2.1
AuthenticationNo cognitive test to sign in (SSO)3.3.8

5. Recording results

Each finding records: screen, criterion, severity, steps, AT and browser, screenshot, fix PR. Findings roll into the ACR as Supports / Partially supports / Does not support / Not applicable, with remarks.

6. ACR production

  1. Complete manual checks on P0 scope.
  2. Fix all "does not support" items on P0 paths, or document a workaround and date.
  3. Fill the VPAT template per criterion with remarks.
  4. Founder reviews; publish to institutions on request, with the test date and scope.
  5. Re-test on every major release; update the ACR at least yearly.

7. Barrier reports

Reports go to access@[domain] and the in-app "Report a barrier" link. Reply within two business days; S2 accessibility barriers on pilot paths get fixed before the next release.
